title: Microsoft Purview: unified Classifiers page for sensitive information types and trainable classifiers
summary: Hold: the access-control row incorrectly says automation is not documented. Microsoft documents Add-RoleGroupMember for managing role-group membership, including Security & Compliance PowerShell. The roadmap facts, rollout notices and Classifiers functionality are otherwise supported.

claims.claim: The roadmap unifies SITs, EDM, fingerprint SITs and trainable classifiers for discovery, creation, validation and management.
claims.quote: The Unified Classification Management Experience unifies every classifier in Microsoft Purview—Sensitive Information Types (SITs), Exact Data Match (EDM), fingerprint SITs, and trainable classifiers—into one place to discover, create, validate, and manage classifiers.

claims.claim: The Classifiers page is a Microsoft Purview administrator management experience.
claims.quote: Microsoft Purview classifiers help administrators identify sensitive content so they can protect and manage it. The Classifiers page brings classification types together in one experience where you can discover, create, inspect, and manage classifiers.

claims.claim: Purview role-group members can be added under Settings > Roles and scopes > Role groups > role group > Edit > Choose users.
claims.quote: Go to Settings > Roles and scopes to view and manage compliance and governance roles in your organization. ... Select Role groups. ... Select Edit on the control bar. ... On Edit members of the role group, select Choose users or Choose groups.

claims.claim: The documented role-group membership procedure requires an administrator assigned Role management.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Microsoft Purview portal by using credentials for an admin account assigned the Role management role.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented automation for the role-group membership that grants Classifiers access.
claims.quote: Use the Add-RoleGroupMember cmdlet to add members to a management role group. ... When you add a member to a role group, the member is given the effective permissions provided by the management roles assigned to the role group.
claims.fix: Replace controls[0].api null with kind powershell, call Add-RoleGroupMember -Identity "<role-group>" -Member "<user-UPN>", and docs https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/exchangepowershell/add-rolegroupmember?view=exchange-ps. Update the rendered API cell to match. Add to the note: 'Security & Compliance PowerShell; manages Purview role-group membership, not Microsoft Entra role assignments.'
